legacy_reference.limitation: The PDF lists subtype ranges, overlapping terms and provisional inclusions. It does not provide an enumerated, versioned 73-entity mapping. Family-heading correspondence does not establish exact entity equivalence.

counting.family_counts: A case contributes at most once to each family and may contribute to several families.
counting.positive_cases: Count distinct positive cases, independently of the sum of family memberships.
counting.unknown_mapping: Preserve an unresolved mapping explicitly; do not assign a family from the nearest name.
